title: Westhoek ERT interface uncertainty: Code, decision log and derived products
description:
Code, software environment, decision log, reported numbers and the values plotted in each figure for the paper Testing Coastal ERT Uncertainty Workflows for Saline Interface Depths Against Independent Soundings (submitted to Water Resources Research).

A pre-registered field test of linearized posterior bands and Bayesian Evidential Learning (BEL) for the depth of the base of an upper saline lens at De Westhoek, Belgium, against independent soundings; synthetic coverage tests; a rule for the direction of the bias of fixed-contour interfaces; and the measured damping of the resistivity below the lens in smooth ERT images.

Code: MIT licence. Results, documents and figure data: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-data). The field data are not included; they come from their own records (Hermans & Paepen 2019, doi:10.14284/390; Vrancken et al. 2026, doi:10.5281/zenodo.20792093). The mechanical CPT logs, the surveyed sounding positions and the 2018 instrument records are not public; the values plotted in Figures S1 and S2 derive from them and are not included.
